name: Install
classification_notes: Described by the designer as a structured, rounded grotesk, placing it in the sans-serif grotesque family with softened corners.
summary: A structured, rounded grotesque offered in ten styles direct from its designer.
description: Install is Arthur Calame's take on a rounded grotesque, keeping a structured skeleton while softening its corners across ten styles. Trials and licensing run directly through the designer rather than an online shop.
foundry_blurb: Calame.Bureau describe Install as a structured and rounded grotesk, available in 10 styles, with trials and licensing available via email.

name: Maroni
classification_notes: Originally cut for the Marronnage exhibition at the Maison de l'Amérique latine, it is a bespoke-origin display face now offered more widely, placing it in the display category.

description: Maroni began as a bespoke display face for the Marronnage exhibition at the Maison de l'Amérique latine and has since been made available more broadly in Regular and Condensed cuts. Trials and licensing are handled directly by the designer.
foundry_blurb: Calame.Bureau describe Maroni as a custom display typeface designed for the Marronnage exhibition at the Maison de l'Amérique latine, with trials and licensing available via email.

name: GR10

foundry_blurb: Calame.Bureau describe GR10 simply as a text typeface, with licensing and trials available via email.

name: Bobine
subcategory: text serif with pixel and cross-stitch detail
classification_notes: A text and title face that folds references to low-resolution digital displays and cross-stitch technique into a classic text-serif structure, keeping it in the serif category.
summary: A text and title serif that mixes low-resolution digital and cross-stitch references into a classic structure.
description: Bobine combines references to low-resolution digital displays, cross-stitch technique and classic text faces in five styles: Regular, Italic, Bold, Bold Italic and Titling. It is licensed through WiseType rather than directly from the designer.
foundry_blurb: Calame.Bureau describe Bobine as a text and title font combining references to low-resolution digital displays, cross-stitch techniques and classic text fonts, released in 2025 with 5 weights.
